title: A uniform influence bound for hypergraph properties
summary: For every fixed integer r ≥ 3, we prove that every relabeling-invariant Boolean property of simple r -uniform hypergraphs on n vertices satisfies $`\mathop{\mathrm{Var}}\nolimits _p(f)\le C_r I_p(f)/(\log n)^{r/(r-1)}`$. The constant depends only on r , and the bound holds uniformly for all $`0\lt p\lt 1`$ without a monotonicity assumption. For increasing properties, it gives the corresponding threshold-width bound with exponent $`r/(r-1)`$, proving the hypergraph threshold-width conjecture of Friedgut and Kalai.
family_title: Uniform influence and sharp thresholds for graph and hypergraph properties

review.reason: Proves a variance-influence bound for hypergraph properties, supporting the threshold-width conjecture.
